## 35b93111c742

**Reproduced defect — generator support omits canonical room-cardinality cases.**
The sampler constructs regular room grids with exactly one non-wall marker in
every room. Across 300 ordinary draws (100 per difficulty), the probe found
1,977 rooms, with 0 zero-marker rooms and 0 multi-marker rooms. Canonical
variant 0 train pair 2 instead contains room marker counts `[2, 0, 1]`.

That restriction leaves a plausible shortcut observationally equivalent on the
sampled support: “fill every room having at least one marker using its first
row-major marker.” On the sampled generator this agrees whenever every room has
exactly one marker. On the canonical witness, the Racket authority leaves the
multi-marker room unchanged, while the rival incorrectly floods it with the
first marker. The selected generator accepted the witness as in-domain; the
Racket output matches the canonical ledger and differs from the rival.

A strict audit also reproduced two contract gaps: there are no task-local tests,
and `semantic_gate --require-contract` fails because the generator declares no
semantic contract. Recommended repair: generate irregular partitions plus
zero-, one-, and multi-marker rooms; declare the exact “fill iff exactly one
marker” rival/witness; and add portable canonical/domain tests.
